props.name: comments
props.description: Top-level comments, oldest first. The caller owns the tree.

props.name: currentUserId
props.description: Whose comments get Edit and Delete.

props.name: onReply
props.description: A reply to a comment, or a new top-level comment when `parentId` is null.

props.name: onReact
props.description: Toggles one reaction for the current person. Omit to hide reactions.

props.name: reactionChoices
props.description: The reactions offered on every comment.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Nesting stops here. Replying at the deepest level answers the parent, with a mention.

props.name: resolved
props.description: Resolved threads hide their composers and read as settled.
